technical_data.url_obfuscation_techniques: The phishing URL uses a valid HTTPS connection with a TLS certificate issued by Sectigo. The domain name closely resembles the legitimate VPN domain, but uses '-secure' as a suffix to deceive users. The link is embedded behind text "login to your VPN account" in the email body to avoid direct URL visibility.

indicators: POST /auth/login.cgi with form data containing employee VPN username and password
HTTP 200 response with JavaScript redirect to legitimate VPN dashboard
Email 'From' address uses a suspicious domain not matching official corporate VPN domain
Newly created domain (less than 5 days old) with WHOIS privacy protection
TLS certificate issued by Sectigo for suspicious domain
User-agent string consistent with Firefox but unusual for corporate VPN login traffic
DNS logs show vpn-enterprise-secure.net resolves to IP 198.51.100.23
samples.detection_method: Detect through DNS monitoring and web proxy blocking domains newly registered that mimic corporate VPN domains. Email security systems flag emails from untrusted domains with mismatched SPF/DKIM. WAF logs reveal POST requests containing credential fields to unknown hosts. Endpoint detection flags unusual VPN login attempts. Browser anti-phishing plugins warn users on suspicious domain names.

technical_data.url_obfuscation_techniques: The phishing URL uses HTTPS with a TLS certificate from DigiCert. The domain name mimics the corporate mail domain by using 'enterpriseweb' instead of 'enterprise'. The link is embedded behind the phrase "log in to your email account" in the email HTML body to avoid direct URL exposure. The phishing site mimics the legitimate OWA login UI closely to avoid suspicion.

indicators: Phishing domain: mail-enterpriseweb.com (typo-squatting with word substitution)
POST /owa/auth.owa with form data containing employee email and password
HTTP 200 response showing generic 'Login Failed' message to avoid suspicion
Email 'From' address uses domain different from official corporate mail domain
Recently registered domain (less than 7 days old) with WHOIS privacy protection
TLS certificate issued by DigiCert for suspicious domain
User-agent string consistent with latest Chrome browser but unusual for internal OWA access
DNS logs show mail-enterpriseweb.com resolving to IP 203.0.114.56
samples.detection_method: DNS and web proxy monitoring to detect and block newly registered domains mimicking corporate mail domains. Email security gateway flags emails from suspicious domains with missing or failing SPF/DKIM checks. WAF logs reveal POST requests containing credential parameters to suspicious hosts. UEBA systems detect abnormal email login activity. Browser anti-phishing extensions warn users of high-risk domains based on reputation scoring.
